task_definition.task_description: Check the status of the living room light, then set the living room AC to 18.5 degrees on eco mode and lock the main door. After that, find the lock ticket for the living room and archive it with the title "Nightly Lockdown Archive" for user Alice with medium priority on the app channel, then send her a message saying "archived". Finally, show me the available meeting rooms for January 17th, 2026.
